key.name: theme
key.description: The look of the taskbar, title bars and window buttons, chosen in Patrone Settings: "patrone" (Patrone's own), "modern" (flat, the taskbar's buttons centered), "classic" (a blue taskbar and title bars, a green Start button) or "studio" (translucent, round colored window buttons). The taskbar follows it; Patrone Settings also puts the theme's style for apps in the account's GTK settings.
